name: Teamwork
overview: Scripture reveals that teamwork is essential to fulfilling God's design for human relationships, beginning with His creation of a suitable helper for man (Genesis 2:18). Unity among believers is both good and pleasant, fostering safety and mutual encouragement as iron sharpens iron (Psalms 133:1; Proverbs 27:17). The wisdom of many counselors provides protection and success, emphasizing that two working together achieve better results than one alone (Proverbs 11:14; Ecclesiastes 4:9). Ultimately, God calls His people to be likeminded in Christ, reflecting His patience and consolation in their cooperative efforts (Romans 15:5).
